name: agentflow
description: Better judgment for AI agents. One decision router and ten portable engineering specialist skills.

interface.longDescription: Better judgment for AI agents. Agentflow routes software engineering decisions to a focused set of eleven portable skills covering product design, architecture, implementation, interface modeling, testing, security, operations and code review. It provides guidance and workflows, not automatic repository access or a separate execution service.
defaultPrompt: Review the architecture boundaries in this backend design.
Find concrete correctness risks in this code change.
Plan targeted tests for a concurrency-sensitive feature.
